datasets.name: Transactions
datasets.sql:
SELECT
  P.rowid,
  p.ID,
  p.OP_ID as OperatorID,
  p.no_prov as OperationNo,
  p.dat as TransactionDate,
  p.DEBT as DebitID,
  ad.ACC_NO as DebitAccNo,(select substr(ad.ACC_NO,9,20) from dual)as D_Accno,
  p.VAL_ACC as DebitCurrencyID,
  dc.val_name as DebitCurrencySName,
  ad.filial as DebitBranch,
  p.KREDIT as CreditID,
  ac.ACC_NO as CreditAccNo,(select substr(ac.ACC_NO,9,20) from dual)as C_Accno,
  p.CurrencyID_C as CreditCurrencyID,
  cc.val_name as CreditCurrencySName,
  ac.filial as CreditBranch,
  p.ammount as DebitAmount,
  p.Ammount_C as CreditAmount,
  p.LAmmount as LAmount,
  p.Rate_D as DebitRate,
  p.Rate_C as CreditRate,
  p.Bank_D as DebitBank,
  p.Bank_K as CreditBank,
  p.NO_PACK as PackageNumber,
  p.SHIFR as CYPHERCODE,
  sb_expertanalyse.getoperationtype(p.vid_op, p.val_acc, p.currencyID_c) as OPERATIONCODE,
  p.Kassa_B as INBALANCECHAR,
  p.Kassa_Z as OUTBALANCECHAR,
  p.NO_FILIAL as FilialID,
  ad.bal_cn1 as DebitBalance,
  p.Name,
  sb_aca.getuserbyid(p.op_id) as usr ,
  sb_aca.getuserbyid(p.commit_opid) as usrcommit ,
  0 as Flags,
  2 as status,
  '' as REJECT_REASON,
  p.reportid,
  p.countrid

FROM
    account ad,
    account ac,
    avalute dc,
    avalute cc,
    provarch p
where
    p.dat =:TransactionDate and p.id=:trid
    and (ad.ID = p.DEBT)
    and (ac.ID = p.KREDIT)
    and (ad.val_acc = p.val_acc)
    and (ac.val_acc = p.CurrencyID_C)
    and (dc.VALUTE = p.val_acc)
    and (cc.VALUTE = p.CurrencyID_C)
    and ((P.OP_ID<>-1 and
          not EXISTS(select SUSER from sba_userman where MUSER=uid and (type#=1 or type#=0)))
          or
          (P.OP_ID in(select SUSER from sba_userman where MUSER=uid and (type#=1 or type#=0))))

union 

SELECT
  P.rowid,
  p.ID,
  p.OP_ID as OperatorID,
  p.no_prov as OperationNo,
  p.dat as TransactionDate,
  p.DEBT as DebitID,
  ad.ACC_NO as DebitAccNo,(select substr(ad.ACC_NO,9,20) from dual)as D_Accno,
  p.VAL_ACC as DebitCurrencyID,
  dc.val_name as DebitCurrencySName,
  ad.filial as DebitBranch,
  p.KREDIT as CreditID,
  ac.ACC_NO as CreditAccNo,(select substr(ac.ACC_NO,9,20) from dual)as C_Accno,
  p.CurrencyID_C as CreditCurrencyID,
  cc.val_name as CreditCurrencySName,
  ac.filial as CreditBranch,
  p.ammount as DebitAmount,
  p.Ammount_C as CreditAmount,
  p.LAmmount as LAmount,
  p.Rate_D as DebitRate,
  p.Rate_C as CreditRate,
  p.Bank_D as DebitBank,
  p.Bank_K as CreditBank,
  p.NO_PACK as PackageNumber,
  p.SHIFR as CYPHERCODE,
  sb_expertanalyse.getoperationtype(p.vid_op, p.val_acc, p.currencyID_c) as OPERATIONCODE,
  p.Kassa_B as INBALANCECHAR,
  p.Kassa_Z as OUTBALANCECHAR,
  p.NO_FILIAL as FilialID,
  ad.bal_cn1 as DebitBalance,
  p.Name,
  sb_aca.getuserbyid(p.op_id) as usr ,
  '' as usrcommit ,

  0 as Flags,
  decode(Rejected, 0, 1, 3) as status,
  RejectReason as REJECT_REASON,
  p.reportid,
  p.countrid


FROM
    account ad,
    account ac,
    avalute dc,
    avalute cc,
    LAZYTRANSACTION p
where
    p.dat =:TransactionDate and p.id=:trid
    and (ad.ID = p.DEBT)
    and (ac.ID = p.KREDIT)
    and (dc.VALUTE = p.val_acc)
    and (cc.VALUTE = p.CurrencyID_C)
  and ((P.OP_ID<>-1 and
        not EXISTS(select SUSER from sba_userman where MUSER=uid and (type#=1 or type#=0)))
        or
        (P.OP_ID in(select SUSER from sba_userman where MUSER=uid and (type#=1 or type#=0))))

Order by :Title

datasets.name: DepozDset
datasets.sql:
select 
       cont.id,
       cont.contractno,
       sbcm_stored_programs.Get_ContractAccount(acc.contractaccid) as ContractAccNO,
       sbcm_stored_programs.Get_ContractAccount(acc.interestaccid) as InterestAccNO,
       av.val_name,
       sbcm_stored_programs.Get_ContractAccountName(acc.contractaccid) as CustomerName,

       --sbcm_stored_programs.get_CustomerNameByID(cont.customerid) as CustomerName,
       --sbcm_stored_programs.get_customername(acc.contractaccid) as CustomerName,
       cont.opendate,
       cont.closedate,
       cont.amount,
       cont.amount*tmp.ostat as ekamount,
       intr.interest,         
       cstate.facticaldebt,
       cstate.facticaldebt*tmp.ostat as ekfacticaldebt,
       cstate.facticalinterestdebt,
       cstate.facticalinterestdebt*tmp.ostat as ekfacticalinterestdebt,
       cstate.stopcalculationdate,
       --SBCM_Stored_Programs.CheckContractState(cont.ID) as  Status,
       cont.currency,
       cont.personaltype,
       cont.clienttype,
       cont.branchid,
       cont.contracttype,
       cstate.calculationenabled as status,
       cont.customerid,
       cont.sid# as usid
from sbcm_contracts cont,
     sbcm_contract_accounts acc,
     sbcm_interests intr,
     sbcm_contract_state cstate,
     avalute av,
     temprate tmp
where acc.id# = cont.id and
      intr.id# = cont.id and
      cstate.id# = cont.id and
      cont.currency = av.valute and
      cont.currency = tmp.val_kod and 
      cont.type# = 3 --Active Deposits
    
     and cont.customerid=:CUSTID
